Storage in this browser

Browsers cap what one site may keep. When this fills up, tools stop being able to save — often silently — so it is worth knowing where you stand.

    End of the school year

    Archiving a year is one workflow, not two: take a full backup, then clear the student data and keep everything you spent the year building. Nothing is cleared until the backup file has actually downloaded.
